measurement.limitations: LOWER BOUND, NOT THE FULL METRIC. This measures only the local Ollama first-token leg over loopback (127.0.0.1:11434, streaming, warm resident model); it EXCLUDES AURA's in-app routing, NLU, policy evaluation and UI render, all of which sit between the user and the first visible token. The user-observed local_dialogue_first_token_ms is therefore strictly larger than these numbers and remains unmeasured. Model: hf.co/GnLOLot/MiniCPM5-1B-...-GGUF:Q8_0 (1.3 GB, 100% GPU) — a 1B model, not necessarily the model the product routes to; the value is model-dependent. granite4.2:8b (5.3 GB) was attempted first and failed to return a first token within a 900 s warmup, so an 8B-class figure could not be obtained. No target is asserted and no pass/fail is claimed. 30 samples after a discarded warmup.

security.evaluator: Cross-agent review under ADR-050, both directions: Claude Code (Opus 5) reviewed deepseek-v4-flash's SP-023/024/025 (Round 2, 2026-08-30, INDEPENDENT_SECURITY_REVIEW_FINDINGS.md); deepseek-v4-flash reviewed Claude Code's F-001 remediation, the beta-readiness contract, F-005 localization, and the R11 authorization pipeline (Round 4, 2026-09-01). Neither agent is independent of the portion it authored; together the two rounds cover the full security surface, each portion reviewed by the other agent. Findings: F-001 (High) fixed; F-002 (Medium, DNS/IP pinning implemented but unenforced) and F-003/F-004 (Low, PID-based peer identity; textual IP normalization) accepted as known risks by the owner with documented rationale and reversibility conditions (RISK_REGISTER.md); F-007 (Medium, validator accepted a fabricated evidence ID) found by Round 4 and fixed same-day. No unresolved Critical/High finding remains.

Live STT/WER is not measured: it requires a speech-capable operator; only the documented synthetic-speech accommodation exists.
The scenario matrix passed as deterministic_harness coverage only; it has NOT been exercised in a live beta window.
The incident review has not run because no beta window has produced incidents to review.
